§bGTNH Planner§r

Exports your recipes and quest progress to your private GitHub data repo, so Claude can plan production lines with what you have actually unlocked.

§eUse§r: /planner sync (or the Home key) after progress; /planner recipes after pack updates. It also syncs by itself shortly after quest changes.
§eSetup§r: token in config/gtnhplanner/token.txt.

§aTask§r: tick the box once you've read this.
